note: ea-parity-b-1123 (EA laptop, correctness only, GPU-limited: no timing). NOT RUN. EA 1.69 parity lane B (docs/334, branch feature/ea169-parity-b): EA asi ts3native 0.36.299-eaparB (sha256 e76a4c2e3c58) + its regenerated EA rc ini (ea-ini.ts, sha256 c1605cef2b58) in game-copy/eaparB-1123/ (copy both there on the EA laptop), ts3fixes.package of the v0.3.1 EA release. Newly ON as Steam ships them: [ThumbStall], [UnseenAnim], [EqualsFast], [Binder] TypeHandleDirect, [GoalValidRO] (Hits=0), [EaCrashFixes] SavedFrameGuard and [RouteAsync] TaskServe (keys ship 1; with draft PR #690's ea-ini.ts they are 0 while unresolved, here resolved). The soak job also turns [GC] IdleGate=1 / SubTimers=1 / MarkHelpers=2 / MarkHelpersVerify=1 on through job ini (the rc ini keeps them 0 as Steam ships them). Same flow as ea-v031-parity-1123; needs the save-reload.ts harness fixes of PR #660. Run: TS3_MACHINE=ea-laptop TS3_LAUNCH=ea node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/ea-parity-b-1123.json
